f.t: Cold weather associated with 2,200 deaths in England last year
f.x: Cold weather was associated with 2,200 deaths in England during winter last year, a new report from the UK Health Security Agency has found. The UKHSA latest cold mortality monitoring report shows that 2,200 deaths were associated with cold weather across five cold weather episodes in 2025/26.

f.t: Five AI tools approved for identifying prostate cancer on MRI scans
f.x: Five artificial intelligence tools for more accurately detecting prostate cancer in MRI scans have been approved for use on the NHS. NICE said the tools have the potential to act like a ‘second pair of eyes’, helping radiologists review prostate MRI scans and improve accuracy and consistency of diagnosis.
